rules.title: Task, hierarchy and purposeful copy
rules.remediation: Map the primary task and reading order; group related information and expose the primary action.
rules.verification: Walk the supplied task; check that competing actions and copy do not obscure its next step.

rules.title: Adopted grid, alignment, gutters, spacing and responsive reflow
rules.remediation: Read project grid sources; set container, flexible columns, gutters, margins and breakpoints together. Fix overflowing children rather than hiding overflow.
rules.verification: Measure viewport and document widths; inspect aligned edges and reading order at supplied desktop and phone sizes.

rules.title: Shared components, consumers and applicable interaction states
rules.remediation: Find the shared primitive and its consumers; repair the root cause while retaining role-specific variants.
rules.verification: Exercise applicable states and inspect affected consumers; source reuse alone does not prove rendered consistency.

rules.title: Icon family, dropdown arrows and selected indicators
rules.remediation: Use the adopted icon family and explicit size/alignment; reserve space for dropdown arrows and checkmarks.
rules.verification: Inspect long labels, open/closed and selected/unselected states; verify no overlap, clipping or duplicate icon.

rules.title: Product-adapted iconography; no unreviewed generator defaults
rules.remediation: Do not use Codex/generator default icons as a design decision. Inspect the target product icon sources and approved Foundation, not the HappyHands shell. Record the adopted family/source, semantic mapping to each affected product action, stroke/fill, optical size, alignment, states and accessibility. Reuse an existing family only with explicit product-fit evidence; select, adapt or create assets when needed. Do not invent custom provenance or replace familiar functional symbols for novelty.
rules.verification: Independently compare every affected icon against the target product and captured states: source/adoption evidence, semantic meaning, family coherence, stroke/fill, optical size/alignment, responsive and applicable interaction states, plus accessible names or decorative hiding. Unreviewed defaults, missing provenance or unobserved states require fail/needs-evidence, never pass. Not-applicable is only for a captured scope containing no icons, with a concrete reason and original screenshot.

rules.title: Evidence-linked page structure and original-image annotations
rules.remediation: Inspect the target product grid, spacing, alignment, component usage and responsive states on each original capture. Preserve adopted design rules rather than imposing universal 8px spacing or column counts. Link each supported structural defect to its original screenshot and finding with normalized bounds; retain unknown or unobserved dimensions as needs-evidence.
rules.verification: Review grid/spacing/alignment/components/responsive separately for every assigned original. Require concrete observations and original-image annotations for supported defects; no missing dimension or unresolved evidence may pass. Derived overlays aid navigation but do not replace originals, source binding or actual interaction evidence.

rules.title: Purposeful feedback and reduced motion
rules.remediation: Remove nonessential motion; use existing timing and reduced-motion behavior for useful feedback.
rules.verification: Exercise the transition and reduced-motion setting; screenshots alone cannot establish a motion pass.

rules.title: Semantic tags and italics
rules.remediation: Remove decorative tags and italics; keep only labels with a clear semantic role.
rules.verification: Check remaining labels aid scanning or state recognition and removed labels lose no essential information.

rules.title: No decorative Instrument Serif / Space Grotesk / Bricolage Grotesque
rules.remediation: Replace unapproved decorative font choices with the adopted project family; preserve intentional brand exceptions.
rules.verification: Inspect computed fonts, fallbacks and wrapping in both supported languages.

rules.title: Monospace only for code or aligned data
rules.remediation: Restrict monospace to code or data whose alignment helps a task; use the text family elsewhere.
rules.verification: Inspect headings, labels and body text separately from code examples.

rules.title: No unnecessary borders, shadows or layered containers
rules.remediation: Remove redundant container layers, separators and shadows; retain boundaries needed to identify controls.
rules.verification: Check hierarchy remains clear and default input boundaries remain visible without focus.

rules.title: Charts support the current decision
rules.remediation: Retain only chart dimensions and annotations needed for the decision; simplify redundant decoration.
rules.verification: Verify labels, units, comparisons and essential uncertainty survive simplification.

rules.title: Professional precise copy without invented terms
rules.remediation: Replace invented terms and chatty filler with established product vocabulary and direct actions.
rules.verification: Read labels in task order; verify concrete meaning and no loss of necessary limitations.

rules.title: No decorative breadcrumbs, numbering or eyebrows
rules.remediation: Remove ornamental eyebrows and numbering; keep breadcrumbs only where they support actual navigation.
rules.verification: Check heading hierarchy and orientation after removal; do not delete functional progress numbering.

rules.title: No decorative purple gradients
rules.remediation: Replace decorative purple gradients with adopted surfaces unless explicitly required by the brand.
rules.verification: Check contrast and hierarchy across supported themes.

rules.title: No decorative uppercase headings
rules.remediation: Replace ornamental uppercase headings with normal case; retain real acronyms.
rules.verification: Check scanning, label width and wrapping.

rules.title: No middle-dot separators in owned copy
rules.remediation: Replace middle-dot separators with spacing or a meaningful sentence structure.
rules.verification: Check paired metadata remains understandable and does not become a run-on label.

rules.title: No decorative Emoji or useless body copy
rules.remediation: Remove decorative Emoji and filler; use meaningful text or adopted icons when identification is needed.
rules.verification: Verify essential warnings and task instructions remain.

rules.title: Hero scale supports the task
rules.remediation: Reduce the hero to a scale that leaves the task and primary action visible in context.
rules.verification: Inspect desktop and phone first view for wrapping, action visibility and content balance.

rules.title: Remove redundant explanations, preserve essential limits
rules.remediation: Delete repeated explanations; retain requirements, consequences and recovery instructions near their action.
rules.verification: Walk the task without relying on removed text to understand an irreversible or unfamiliar action.

rules.title: Concentric nested radii
rules.remediation: Derive nested radii from outer radius and inset where the surfaces are concentric.
rules.verification: Inspect corners at actual render sizes; avoid forcing unrelated adjacent objects into one radius formula.

rules.title: Consistent hairlines; separate focus/icon strokes
rules.remediation: Use adopted hairline/border tokens consistently; keep focus indicators and icon strokes independently accessible.
rules.verification: Inspect default, focus and both themes; a thinner border must remain perceptible.

rules.title: Restrained scroll motion and transitions
rules.remediation: Remove excessive scroll reveals and abrupt transitions; use restrained adopted motion.
rules.verification: Scroll and trigger transitions with reduced motion on and off; record missing runtime evidence.

rules.title: At most four rendered text sizes, minimum 12px
rules.remediation: Consolidate owned interface text into at most four size roles, none below 12px; do not restyle embedded source specimens.
rules.verification: Inspect computed sizes and long labels across breakpoints, including helper text.

rules.title: No decorative colored left card stripe
rules.remediation: Remove purely decorative colored left stripes; express necessary status through a clear label and adopted treatment.
rules.verification: Check status remains perceivable without color alone.

rules.title: Dropdown trigger, menu, selected, focus and keyboard states
rules.remediation: Repair the shared dropdown trigger, popup padding, item gaps, selected indicator and focus behavior.
rules.verification: Open, select, reopen, use arrows/Enter/Escape, and inspect disabled options, long labels, scrolling and focus return.

rules.title: Adjacent controls remain distinct
rules.remediation: Add consistent spacing between adjacent controls and separate label, value and action roles.
rules.verification: Inspect narrow layouts and long labels for collisions and misleading grouping.

rules.title: Necessary information is not unnecessarily collapsed
rules.remediation: Keep essential instructions visible; use disclosure only for genuinely optional detail.
rules.verification: Verify the default state supports the task and expanded content has adequate spacing.

rules.title: Reuse actual adopted component primitives
rules.remediation: Reuse the project-adopted primitive instead of parallel hand-built controls; preserve justified variations.
rules.verification: Inspect imports and actual rendered consumers, including keyboard and state behavior.

rules.title: Consistent radius for the same component role
rules.remediation: Apply consistent radius tokens to components with the same role and size.
rules.verification: Compare like-for-like inputs, buttons, menus and cards; do not erase purposeful role distinctions.

rules.title: No duplicate navigation or redundant nested shells
rules.remediation: Remove duplicate navigation and redundant shells; retain a single clear current-location indicator.
rules.verification: Navigate between related views and inspect active state, back behavior and small-screen layout.

rules.title: HappyHands homepage cover orbit and readable foreground
rules.remediation: On the HappyHands homepage only, preserve the existing archive covers, spiral orbit, and Hero content. Use the approved Three.js/WebGL perspective for near-large and far-small covers, a short opening tilt, and gentle pointer depth. Keep the title, actions and glass header readable. This approved exception applies to the orbit under UX-motion and AS-16; keep other motion restrained.
rules.verification: Inspect timed browser frames and actual interaction records for opening, pointer response, scroll exit and resume. Check desktop and phone, both themes, static reduced motion, and usable cover fallback when WebGL is unavailable or lost. A still image alone is needs-evidence for motion.

rules.title: Single glass silhouette for the homepage Hero logo
rules.remediation: Keep the original HappyHands mark. Use one silhouette with its highlight clipped within the logo alpha. Remove a duplicated mask, offset shadow or second copy that creates a ghost edge. Scope the repair to the Hero mark.
rules.verification: Check the mark at normal desktop and phone sizes in both themes. Inspect its real rendered outline and source layers; verify the edges and sparkle are distinct and there is no second silhouette.

workflow.instruction: Inspect the current page first against every applicable own AI slop rule and the recorded recurring UI defects. Record evidence, not preferences.
Repair root causes in shared components and verify current-page default, hover, open, selected, focus and keyboard behavior where applicable.
Verify task flow, information hierarchy, copy, component relationships and the adopted current-page grid.
Only after current-page remediation, check phone and other supported sizes for reflow and regressions. Responsive fixes do not substitute for current-page experience work.
